concerns.text: T008 (Phase 0) depends on T037 (Phase 5) for URL verification, creating a circular dependency that blocks Phase 0. T008 claims to validate citations per Constitution Principle II, but cannot run until Phase 5 completes, violating the 'Blocking Prerequisites' definition and Constitution Principle II's gate requirement.

Phase 6 (T040-T045) implements 'Einstein Review Resolution' based on a simulated review not present in spec.md or plan.md. This introduces unauthorized scope creep and gold-plating, violating the Single Source of Truth (Constitution Principle IV) and FR-030 by adding requirements not traced to the spec.

T017 requires validation against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` but the task description notes the schema is missing (generated by T013 in Phase 1). T017 cannot execute as written without the artifact, violating the dependency chain and creating an untestable deliverable.

T020/T021 implement autocorrelation correction (AR(1) pre-whitening, Newey-West SE) described in plan.md but not mandated by any FR in spec.md. This introduces implementation complexity not traced to a specific functional requirement, risking scope drift and violating the traceability matrix.

T028 implements sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds but spec.md SC-003 defines the threshold set as '{, 0.6}' (missing lower bound). The task cannot verify the specific acceptance criterion from the spec, creating an untestable deliverable due to the spec's syntax error.
